source_refs.note: Exercise 1.4, Question 2: book p. 28, Q2 (i)-(vi) exponential and logarithmic inequalities; answer key book p. 299 (PDF 301)

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Solve the inequality (if its solution exists): \(2^x + 2^{1-x} \le 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain: yeh exponential inequality hai jis mein \(2^x\) aur \(2^{1-x}\) hain, aur \(2^{1-x} = \frac{2}{2^x}\).
Diya kya hai? \(2^x + 2^{1-x} \le 3\). Find kya karna hai? Woh tamam \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Rule kaunsa? Substitution \(y = 2^x\); kyunke \(y > 0\), us se multiply karne par nishan nahi badalta.
Plan: quadratic inequality hal karna, phir wapas \(x\) par aana (base 2 > 1, nishan wohi).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2^x + 2^{1-x} \le 3\).
Maloom karna: tamam real \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Tareeqa: \(2^{1-x} = \frac{2}{2^x}\), is liye \(y = 2^x\) rakhne se \(y + \frac{2}{y} \le 3\) milta hai. \(y\) hamesha positive hai, to \(y\) se multiply karna mehfooz hai.

Domain
\[\text{Domain} = ]-\infty, \infty[\]
Kyun: exponentials har real number ke liye maujood hain.

\(y = 2^x\) rakhein (\(y > 0\))
\[y + \dfrac{2}{y} \le 3\]
\[y^2 + 2 \le 3y\]
\[y^2 - 3y + 2 \le 0\]
\[(y - 1)(y - 2) \le 0\]
Kyun: \(y > 0\), is liye \(y\) se multiply karne par nishan nahi badalta.
Dhyan dein: agar multiplier ka sign maloom na ho to inequality ko us se multiply nahi karte; yahan \(y > 0\) pakka hai.

\(y\) ke liye hal
\[1 \le y \le 2\]
Kyun: do factors ka product \(\le 0\) tab hota hai jab \(y\) roots 1 aur 2 ke darmiyan ho (ek factor negative, doosra positive, ya koi zero).

Wapas \(x\) par
\[2^0 \le 2^x \le 2^1\]
\[0 \le x \le 1\]
Kyun: base \(2 > 1\), is liye \(2^x\) increasing hai aur nishan wohi rehte hain. \(1 = 2^0\) aur \(2 = 2^1\) likhne se powers seedhi compare ho gayin.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 0.5\): \(2^{0.5} + 2^{0.5} = 2\sqrt{2} \approx 2.83 \le 3\) \(\checkmark\)
\(x = 2\): \(4 + 0.5 = 4.5 > 3\), bahar, jaisa hona chahiye.
Kinare: \(x = 0\) par \(1 + 2 = 3\), \(x = 1\) par \(2 + 1 = 3\); barabari ki ijazat hai, is liye dono kinare shamil.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Solve the inequality (if its solution exists): \(2^x \ge \log_2(16)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sab se aasan part hai: right side sirf ek number hai, \(\log_2 16 = 4\).
Diya kya hai? \(2^x \ge \log_2(16)\). Find kya karna hai? Woh tamam \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Rule kaunsa? 4 ko 2 ki power likh kar exponents compare karna; base 2 > 1, nishan wohi.
Plan: right side simplify, powers compare, aur answer interval ki sahi shakal mein likhna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2^x \ge \log_2(16)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Tareeqa: pehle right side ko simplify karenge, phir usay 2 ki power likh kar \(2^x\) ke increasing hone ka faida uthayenge.

Domain
\[\text{Domain} = ]-\infty, \infty[\]
Kyun: \(2^x\) har real number ke liye maujood hai, aur \(\log_2 16\) to bas ek fixed number hai.

Right side simplify karein
\[\log_2 16 = \log_2 2^4 = 4\]
\[2^x \ge 4 = 2^2\]
Kyun: \(\log_a a^k = k\). Yani "2 ki kaunsi power 16 deti hai?" Jawab: 4.
Dhyan dein: is sawal mein \(x\) ko log ke andar samajh lena ghalti hai; log sirf right side ke number par hai.

Exponents compare karein
\[x \ge 2\]
Kyun: base \(2 > 1\), is liye exponential function increasing hai aur nishan wohi rehta hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 3\): \(8 \ge 4\) \(\checkmark\)
\(x = 1\): \(2 \ge 4\) ghalat, jaisa hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(S = [2, \infty]\) chhapa hai. \(\infty\) koi real number nahi, is liye woh kabhi shamil nahi ho sakta; \(\infty\) ki taraf bracket hamesha khula hota hai. Sahi jawab: \(S = [2, \infty[\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Solve the inequality (if its solution exists): \(\log_2(x - 1) \ge \log_2(5 - x)\).
blocks.explanation:
Dono taraf base 2 ke logarithms hain.
Diya kya hai? \(\log_2(x - 1) \ge \log_2(5 - x)\). Find kya karna hai? Woh tamam \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Rule kaunsa? Base \(2 > 1\), is liye \(\log_2\) increasing hai aur log hatane par nishan wohi.
Plan: domain, logarithm hatana, linear inequality hal karna, aur domain se intersection; kinaron par khaas dhyan.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\log_2(x - 1) \ge \log_2(5 - x)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Tareeqa: pehle domain; phir \(\log_2\) increasing hone ki wajah se arguments mein bhi wohi tarteeb rahegi.

Domain
\[x - 1 > 0 \Rightarrow x > 1\]
\[5 - x > 0 \Rightarrow x < 5\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]1, 5[\]
Kyun: dono logarithms ko positive argument chahiye; dono shartein mil kar \(1\) aur \(5\) ke darmiyan ka faasla deti hain.

Logarithm hatayein
\[x - 1 \ge 5 - x\]
\[2x \ge 6\]
\[x \ge 3\]
Kyun: base \(2 > 1\), is liye nishan wohi rehta hai. Phir \(x\) wali terms ek taraf aur positive 2 se divide.

Domain se milayein
\[3 \le x < 5\]
Kyun: \(x \ge 3\) aur \(1 < x < 5\) ek saath. Kinara 5 khula hai, kyunke \(x = 5\) par \(\log_2(5 - 5) = \log_2 0\) maujood nahi.
Dhyan dein: algebra wala hissa \(x \ge 3\) kehta hai ke 5 bhi chalega, lekin domain usay rok deta hai. Isi liye aakhri qadam zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 4\): \(\log_2 3 \approx 1.585 \ge \log_2 1 = 0\) \(\checkmark\)
\(x = 2\): \(\log_2 1 = 0 \ge \log_2 3\) ghalat, jaisa hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(S = [3, 5]\) chhapa hai. Lekin \(x = 5\) par \(\log_2(5 - x) = \log_2 0\) banta hai jo maujood hi nahi, is liye 5 ko nikalna zaroori hai. Sahi jawab: \(S = [3, 5[\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Solve the inequality (if its solution exists): \(\log_{\frac{1}{3}}(x^2 - 4x + 3) > \log_{\frac{1}{3}}(2x - 1)\).
blocks.explanation:
Dono taraf base \(\frac{1}{3}\) ke logarithms hain, aur yeh base 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\log_{\frac{1}{3}}(x^2 - 4x + 3) > \log_{\frac{1}{3}}(2x - 1)\). Find kya karna hai? Tamam \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Rule kaunsa? Base 1 se chhota hai, function decreasing hai, is liye log hatate waqt nishan ulat jayega.
Plan: domain (do hisson mein), nishan ulat kar quadratic inequality, roots, aur domain ke har hisse se intersection.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\log_{\frac{1}{3}}(x^2 - 4x + 3) > \log_{\frac{1}{3}}(2x - 1)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Tareeqa: pehle domain; phir \(0 < \frac{1}{3} < 1\) hone ki wajah se \(\log_{\frac{1}{3}}\) decreasing hai, yani bara logarithm chhote argument ka hota hai, is liye nishan ulta hoga.

Domain
\[x^2 - 4x + 3 = (x - 1)(x - 3) > 0\]
\[\Rightarrow x < 1 \text{ or } x > 3\]
\[2x - 1 > 0 \Rightarrow x > \tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]\tfrac{1}{2}, 1[ \cup ]3, \infty[\]
Kyun: dono arguments ek hi waqt positive hone chahiyen. Pehli shart do hisse deti hai, doosri shart \(x > \frac{1}{2}\) unhein kaat deti hai.

Logarithm hatayein (nishan ulta)
\[x^2 - 4x + 3 < 2x - 1\]
\[x^2 - 6x + 4 < 0\]
Kyun: base \(\frac{1}{3}\) 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai, function decreasing hai, is liye \(>\) badal kar \(<\) ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: yahan nishan na ulatna is sawal ki sab se bari ghalti hai.

\(x^2 - 6x + 4 = 0\) ke roots
\[x = \dfrac{6 \pm \sqrt{36 - 16}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{6 \pm 2\sqrt{5}}{2} = 3 \pm \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: quadratic formula, \(a = 1,\ b = -6,\ c = 4\); \(\sqrt{20} = 2\sqrt{5}\).

Quadratic kahan negative hai
\[3 - \sqrt{5} < x < 3 + \sqrt{5}\]
(lagbhag \(0.764 < x < 5.236\))
Kyun: upar khulne wali parabola apne roots ke darmiyan negative hoti hai.

Domain se milayein
\[]\tfrac{1}{2}, 1[ \cap ]3 - \sqrt{5}, 3 + \sqrt{5}[\]
\[= ]3 - \sqrt{5}, 1[\]
\[]3, \infty[ \cap ]3 - \sqrt{5}, 3 + \sqrt{5}[\]
\[= ]3, 3 + \sqrt{5}[\]
Kyun: \(3 - \sqrt{5} \approx 0.764\) number \(\frac{1}{2}\) se bara hai, is liye pehla hissa \(3 - \sqrt{5}\) se shuru hota hai, \(\frac{1}{2}\) se nahi. Doosre hisse mein \(3 + \sqrt{5}\) par khatam.

Test points se tasdeeq (\(L\) = left side, \(R\) = right side):
\(x = 0.6\): \(L \approx 0.037\), \(R \approx 1.465\): \(L > R\) ghalat, yani \(0.6\) hal nahi.
\(x = 0.9\): \(L \approx 1.421\), \(R \approx 0.203\): sahi.
\(x = 4\): \(L = -1\), \(R \approx -1.771\): sahi.
\(x = 6\): \(L \approx -2.465\), \(R \approx -2.183\): ghalat.
Kyun: andar ke points poore utarte hain aur bahar ke nahi; jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(S = ]\frac{1}{2}, 1[ \cup ]3, 3 + \sqrt{5}[\) chhapa hai. Pehla hissa ghalat hai: wahan bhi \(x^2 - 6x + 4 < 0\) poora hona chahiye, jo usay \(]3 - \sqrt{5}, 1[\) tak chhota kar deta hai. Misaal: \(x = 0.6\) key ke interval mein hai, lekin \(\log_{\frac{1}{3}} 0.96 \approx 0.037\), \(\log_{\frac{1}{3}} 0.2 \approx 1.465\) se bara nahi. Sahi jawab: \(S = ]3 - \sqrt{5}, 1[ \cup ]3, 3 + \sqrt{5}[\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (v) Solve the inequality (if its solution exists): \(\log_2(x - 2) + \log_2(x - 3) \ge 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Left side par base 2 ke do logarithms hain aur right side par sirf number 3.
Diya kya hai? \(\log_2(x - 2) + \log_2(x - 3) \ge 3\). Find kya karna hai? Tamam \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Rule kaunsa? Product law, aur 3 ko \(\log_2 8\) likhna, taa ke dono taraf ek jaise logarithm hon.
Plan: domain, product law, log hatana (nishan wohi), quadratic inequality, domain se intersection.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\log_2(x - 2) + \log_2(x - 3) \ge 3\).
Maloom karna: tamam real \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Tareeqa: left side ko product law se jorenge aur 3 ko base 2 ka logarithm bana denge, phir dono taraf compare ho sakenge.

Domain
\[x - 2 > 0 \text{ and } x - 3 > 0\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]3, \infty[\]
Kyun: asal inequality ke har logarithm ko positive argument chahiye.
Dhyan dein: domain asal sawal se lein, jore hue \(\log_2[(x - 2)(x - 3)]\) se nahi; woh \(x < 2\) ko bhi ijazat de deta jahan asal logs maujood nahi.

Product law aur \(3 = \log_2 8\)
\[\log_2[(x - 2)(x - 3)] \ge \log_2 8\]
Kyun: \(\log_2 m + \log_2 n = \log_2(mn)\) aur \(\log_2 2^3 = 3\).

Logarithm hatayein
\[(x - 2)(x - 3) \ge 8\]
\[x^2 - 5x + 6 - 8 \ge 0\]
\[x^2 - 5x - 2 \ge 0\]
Kyun: base \(2 > 1\), is liye nishan wohi.

\(x^2 - 5x - 2 = 0\) ke roots
\[x = \dfrac{5 \pm \sqrt{25 + 8}}{2} = \dfrac{5 \pm \sqrt{33}}{2}\]
(lagbhag \(-0.372\) aur \(5.372\))
Quadratic roots ke bahar \(\ge 0\) hai:
\[x \le \dfrac{5 - \sqrt{33}}{2} \text{ or } x \ge \dfrac{5 + \sqrt{33}}{2}\]
Kyun: upar khulne wali parabola apne roots ke bahar non-negative hoti hai.

Domain se milayein
\(\frac{5 - \sqrt{33}}{2}\) negative hai, is liye us hisse mein \(x > 3\) wala koi point nahi. Sirf \(x \ge \frac{5 + \sqrt{33}}{2}\) bachta hai (aur \(5.372 > 3\)).
Kyun: jawab \(]3, \infty[\) ke andar bhi hona chahiye.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 6\): \(\log_2 4 + \log_2 3 \approx 2 + 1.585 = 3.585 \ge 3\) \(\checkmark\)
\(x = 5\): \(\log_2 3 + \log_2 2 \approx 2.585 < 3\), bahar, jaisa hona chahiye.
\(x = \frac{5 + \sqrt{33}}{2}\) par \((x - 2)(x - 3) = 8\), yani left side bilkul 3 hai, is liye kinara shamil.

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Solve the inequality (if its solution exists): \(\log(x) + \log(x - 3) \ge \log(2x) + \log(x - 1)\).
blocks.explanation:
Dono taraf base 10 ke do do logarithms hain. Sawal kehta hai "agar hal maujood ho": yahan hal maujood nahi, aur yeh bhi ek jawab hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\log(x) + \log(x - 3) \ge \log(2x) + \log(x - 1)\). Find kya karna hai? Tamam \(x\), agar koi ho.
Rule kaunsa? Dono taraf product law, phir log hatana (base 10 > 1, nishan wohi).
Plan: domain, product law, algebra, aur domain se intersection; khali set aaye to saaf likhna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\log(x) + \log(x - 3) \ge \log(2x) + \log(x - 1)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real \(x\) jo is ko poora karein, agar koi ho.
Tareeqa: har taraf product law se ek logarithm banayenge, phir arguments compare karenge (base 10 increasing hai).

Domain
\[x > 0,\ x > 3,\ x > 0,\ x > 1\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]3, \infty[\]
Kyun: chaaron arguments \(x,\ x - 3,\ 2x,\ x - 1\) positive hone chahiyen; chaaron ek saath sirf \(x > 3\) par poore hote hain.

Dono taraf product law
\[\log[x(x - 3)] \ge \log[2x(x - 1)]\]
Kyun: \(\log m + \log n = \log(mn)\).

Logarithm hatayein
\[x^2 - 3x \ge 2x^2 - 2x\]
\[0 \ge x^2 + x\]
\[x(x + 1) \le 0\]
Kyun: base \(10 > 1\), is liye nishan wohi. Phir sab terms right side par le gaye.

Hal karein
\[-1 \le x \le 0\]
Kyun: product \(x(x + 1)\) apne roots \(-1\) aur \(0\) ke darmiyan \(\le 0\) hota hai.

Domain se milayein
Koi number aisa nahi jo \(-1 \le x \le 0\) bhi ho aur \(x > 3\) bhi. Is liye inequality ka koi hal nahi.
Kyun: algebra wala hissa aur domain ek doosre ko chhoote hi nahi; intersection khali set hai.

Tasdeeq:
Har \(x > 3\) ke liye \(x < 2x\) aur \(x - 3 < x - 1\), is liye \(x(x - 3) < 2x(x - 1)\): left side hamesha chhoti hai. Misaal \(x = 4\): \(\log 4 + \log 1 \approx 0.602\), jab ke \(\log 8 + \log 3 \approx 1.380\).
